hero.headline: SITE ENGINEERING SURVEYS
hero.title: Survey Smarter, Build Stronger
hero.description: Leading Africa's Land and Aerial Surveying Revolution. Build Smarter from the Ground Up—our drone-enabled site engineering surveys deliver precise measurements, rapid terrain insights, and informed decision-making for your construction projects.

overview.headline: Reliable. Scalable. Fast. Powerful.
overview.description: By capturing high-resolution topographic data, 3D ground models, and accurate boundary visuals, we streamline site planning and reduce costly rework. Whether you're breaking ground or managing infrastructure upgrades, SmartGrid Surveying gives you the geospatial clarity needed to engineer with confidence and precision.

services.headline: Site Engineering Services
services.description: We provide a comprehensive suite of site engineering services to support every phase of your construction project, from planning to completion.

items.title: Leveling
items.description: Precise leveling services to establish accurate elevation benchmarks and ensure proper grading for construction.

items.title: Excavation Services
items.description: Providing detailed excavation plans and volume calculations to guide earthmoving operations.

items.title: As-built Surveys
items.description: Documenting final construction conditions to verify compliance with design specifications and support asset management.

items.title: Buildings Stakeout
items.description: Accurately marking out building positions, foundations, and structural elements on site for construction crews.

items.title: Utilities Mapping
items.description: Identifying, mapping, and documenting existing and new utility networks to prevent conflicts and ensure safety.

items.title: Evaluation and Monitoring
items.description: Ongoing assessment of site conditions, progress tracking, and change detection for quality control.
